description:
Make 2 to 12 thumbnails (default 4): 3 different concepts first, then images (Nano
    Banana 2.1, 1K or 4K), every printed word read back and checked letter by letter, a face
    only from your photos or your channel's own thumbnails. Answers at once with call_id and
    status pending; read it with get_thumbnails until done. 4 credits a delivered 1K image, 12
    a 4K one, charged only for what is delivered. Same as POST /v1/thumbnails.

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

name: make_thumbnails
